nodes.title: Input Text (Prompt)
widgets_values:
Bold comic-book ink style, heavy linework, red and blue-black palette, night city. Use <Picture 2> and <Picture 1> as reference frames and <Audio 1> exactly as it is.
CUT 1: top-down view of the little boy superhero on the rooftop — red cape fluttering in the wind, hands planted on his hips, freckles and a cocky grin as he looks straight up into the camera. The camera slowly descends toward him as he delivers his line — as he speaks, comic-book graphic overlay text word by word in sync with his voice: "GET READY TO" - "MEET" — "YOUR" — "MAKER" — huge jagged comic lettering, white with heavy black outlines and red drop shadows, tilted at scrappy angles, until the three words hang stacked in the air above him between his face and the lens.
TRANSITION: a violent WHIP PAN off the rooftop that SMEARS the floating words away with it, motion-streaked —
CUT 2: low hero angle on the colossal black mech-kaiju towering over the skyline as it rears back and unleashes a GIANT terrifying ROAR — jaws wide with fangs, red eyes and chest-core flaring blinding bright, blue lightning arcing off its head, the roar's shockwave rippling dust and rattling windows down the buildings, comic-style speed-lines and ink splatter bursting from the impact of the sound. It leans INTO the camera as the roar peaks. Hold on the roar.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
- Picture 1: A reference image showing a 2D illustrated cat character with glowing blue eyes, futuristic sci-fi goggles, headphones, and a black outfit with the text "POBREIA".
- Audio 1: A 7-second voiceover saying: "Hola! Por fin llegó el workflow que tanto esperabas. Veamos cómo utilizar Minimax en una PC miserable como la tuya!"

summary:
A 10-second horizontal 16:9 cinematic video featuring the 2D cartoon cat character from Picture 1 centered in the foreground, speaking synchronously with the voice from Audio 1 during the first 7 seconds, set against a hyper-detailed, epic 3D CGI sci-fi battle background with massive explosions, vibrant neon colors, and dramatic cinematic lighting.

retention_analysis:
- The exact 2D art style, colors, goggles, and character design of the cat from Picture 1 are strictly preserved in the foreground.
- The background depicts a grand, chaotic sci-fi battlefield with soaring spacecraft, glowing energy blasts, and epic cinematic debris, running for the full 10 seconds.
- Lip-sync animation maps perfectly to the 7-second voice track of Audio 1, followed by a confident posture pose for the remaining 3 seconds.

detailed_description:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Horizontal 16:9 framing. In the center foreground, the 2D animated cat character from <Picture 1> stands dynamically, maintaining its vibrant cell-shaded look. For the first 7 seconds, the cat's mouth and expressions synchronize precisely with the speech audio from <Audio 1>. Behind the character, a breathtaking, hyper-realistic 3D CGI sci-fi warzone unfolds: massive structures crumble under orange and blue explosions, energy beams streak across a dark nebula sky, and glowing neon lights illuminate the smoke and debris. For the final 3 seconds, the cat strikes an epic triumphant pose as the background battle reaches a crescendo.

overall_soundscape:
Synchronized voiceover from Audio 1 for the first 7 seconds. Newly generated voice matching <Audio 1>'s vocal timbre and speaker identity, clean and isolated with zero background audio or music interference.

non_diegetic_music:
An epic, high-octane orchestral sci-fi battle theme with heavy brass and electronic synthesizers.
